title: VISE: Verifier-Independent Skill Self-Evolution with Feedback from Tool Implementations
abstract: arXiv:2611.32480v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agent skills provide reusable workflows that guide LLM agents in using tools. Refining these workflows requires feedback on missing or incorrect instructions, but task-specific verifiers are not always available. We propose VISE (Verifier-Independent Skill Evolution), a scripts-first approach that uses tool implementations to guide skill revision. It extracts tool capabilities, input requirements, usage conditions, and output formats from source code. Using the task request and execution trace, it compares this information with current workflow instructions to identify missing or conflicting steps. It then recommends specific edits to SKILL.md, linking each change to the relevant implementation and usage conditions. We evaluate VISE as an additional revision stage for four evolution methods on SkillsBench and SkillLearnBench. Compared with the corresponding No-verifier conditions, it improves overall average task success by 9.14-13.35 pe

translated_title: VISE：基于工具实现反馈的、无需验证器的技能自进化方法
translated_abstract: 智能体技能为LLM智能体使用工具提供了可复用的工作流程。改进这些工作流程需要关于缺失或错误指令的反馈，但针对特定任务的验证器并不总是可用。我们提出了VISE（无验证器技能进化），这是一种“脚本优先”的方法，利用工具实现来指导技能修订。它从源代码中提取工具的能力、输入要求、使用条件和输出格式。利用任务请求和执行轨迹，它将这些信息与当前工作流程指令进行比较，以识别缺失或冲突的步骤。然后，它为SKILL.md推荐具体的编辑，并将每项更改与相关的实现和使用条件关联起来。我们在SkillsBench和SkillLearnBench上评估了VISE作为四种进化方法的附加修订阶段的效果。与相应的无验证器条件相比，它将整体平均任务成功率提高了9.14-13.35个百分点。
tldr: VISE提出了一种无需任务特定验证器的技能自进化方法，通过从工具源代码中提取能力、输入要求、使用条件和输出格式等信息来指导技能工作流的修订，在两个基准上将平均任务成功率提升了9.14-13.35个百分点。
